titulo.estudio: Un avis de santé : Lire l'ensemble

intro: Read short instructions for a consultation without confusing symptoms, time and place. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Read short instructions for a consultation without confusing symptoms, time and place. First look for names, days, places and figures: in notices and forms these are usually easy to find.
Point to note: the instructions use the imperative; a frequency such as « deux fois par jour » goes with the action. In this passage, «rendez-vous» means «appointment».

frases.estudio: Le centre médical reçoit les patients sur rendez-vous le matin.
frases.alumno: The medical centre sees patients by appointment in the morning.

frases.estudio: Pour prendre rendez-vous, appelez le numéro indiqué sur la porte.
frases.alumno: To make an appointment, call the number shown on the door.

frases.estudio: La salle d'attente se trouve au premier étage, à droite.
frases.alumno: The waiting room is on the first floor, on the right.

frases.estudio: En cas d'urgence, adressez-vous à l'accueil de l'hôpital.
frases.alumno: In an emergency, go to the reception desk of the hospital.
